segments.sn4.20:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati himavantapadese [himavantapasse (sī.)] araññakuṭikāyaṃ.
segments.sn4.20:1.2: Atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.sn4.20:1.3: “sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā”ti?
segments.sn4.20:2.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn4.20:2.2: “kāretu, bhante, bhagavā rajjaṃ, kāretu, sugato, rajjaṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā”ti.
segments.sn4.20:2.3: “Kiṃ pana me tvaṃ, pāpima, passasi yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadesi –
segments.sn4.20:2.4: ‘kāretu, bhante, bhagavā rajjaṃ, kāretu sugato, rajjaṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā’”ti?
segments.sn4.20:2.5: “Bhagavatā kho, bhante, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā.
segments.sn4.20:2.6: Ākaṅkhamāno ca, bhante, bhagavā himavantaṃ pabbatarājaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ tveva adhimucceyya suvaṇṇañca panassā”ti [suvaṇṇapabbatassāti (sī. syā. kaṃ.), suvaṇṇañca pabbatassāti (pī.)].
segments.sn4.20:5.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
segments.sn4.20:6.3: Pattaṃ āyatanaṃ piṇḍaṃ, kassakaṃ rajjena te dasāti.

lines: Iti bhagavā adhammikarājūnaṃ rajje vijite daṇḍakarapīḷite manusse disvā kāruññavasena evaṃ cintesi.

Upasaṅkamīti “samaṇo gotamo ‘sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretun’ti cintesi, rajjaṃ kāretukāmo bhavissati, rajjañca nāmetaṃ pamādaṭṭhānaṃ, rajjaṃ kārente sakkā otāraṃ labhituṃ, gacchāmi ussāhamassa janessāmī”ti cintetvā upasaṅkami.
Paricitāti sātaccakiriyāya suparicitā katā issāsassa avirādhitavedhihattho viya.
Dvittāvāti tiṭṭhatu eko pabbato, dvikkhattumpi tāva mahanto suvaṇṇapabbato ekassa nālaṃ, na pariyattoti attho.
Iti vidvā samañcareti evaṃ jānanto samaṃ careyya.
Yatonidānanti dukkhaṃ nāma pañcakāmaguṇanidānaṃ, taṃ yatonidānaṃ hoti, evaṃ yo adakkhi.
Kathaṃ nameyyāti so jantu tesu dukkhassa nidānabhūtesu kāmesu kena kāraṇena nameyya.
Upadhiṃ viditvāti kāmaguṇaupadhiṃ “saṅgo eso, lagganametan”ti evaṃ viditvā.
Tasseva jantu vinayāya sikkheti tasseva upadhissa vinayāya sikkheyya.
Ahananti karaṇe paccattavacananti āha “ahanantenā”ti, paccatte eva vā paccattavacanaṃ,“ahananto hutvā”ti vacanasesena bhavitabbanti adhippāyo.
Kasmā bhagavā evaṃ cintesīti tattha kāraṇamāha “itī”tiādinā.
Rajje vijite daṇḍakarapīḷiteti dhanadaṇḍādidaṇḍena ceva balinā ca bādhite.
Yuttayānanti yathā yuttānaṃ ājaññarathānaṃ sārathinā adhiṭṭhitaṃ yathāruci pavattati, evaṃ yathārucipavattitaṃ gamitā.
Vatthukatāti sabbaso upakkilesasodhanena iddhivisayatāya patiṭṭhānabhāvato suvisodhitaparissayavatthu viya katā.
Niccānubaddhāti tato eva niccaṃ anubaddhā viya katā.
Dvikkhattumpi tāva mahantoti yattako so pabbato hoti, dvikkhattuṃ tattako.
Ekassāti ekassapi puggalassa nālaṃ na pariyatto taṇhāya duppūraṇabhāvā.
Samaṃ careyyāti paravatthuparāmāsādiṃ vihāya kāyādīhi samameva paṭipajjeyya.
Dukkhaṃ taṇhānidānaṃ, taṇhā kāmaguṇanidānā, tasmā dukkhassa taṇhāpaccayakāmaguṇanidānattaṃ vuttaṃ.
Evaṃ yo adakkhīti yo pariññātavatthuko evaṃ dukkhaṃ tassa nidānabhūte kāmaguṇe ca tathato paññācakkhunā passi.
Sajjati etthāti saṅgo eso, lagganametanti evaṃ viditvā.
Tameva kāmābhibhūto nappaṭiseveyya na laggeyyāti evaṃ vinayāya vūpasamāya sikkheyyāti.
